Name: Friendly Hutch Slimes
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=4]You raised these Slimes from eggs, and [i]this [/i]is how they repay you???[/size][/quote]
[b][color=#93c47d]Slimes [/color][/b]in your Hutch (or those same Slimes outside the Hutch, if they somehow escape) are now friendly.
- Offensive Trinkets like the Ice Rod, Frog Egg, Magic Quiver wont target them!

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+  
• SMAPI
